note: Created from the 2026-11-18 PRD/playbook text. Every row is 'not-implemented' until code and executed tests are linked. Market-adoption targets in the PRD are pilot hypotheses, not results. All services must default unpublished/unshared and feature-flag off.

prdRequirements.requirement: Owner opts in per store, confirms public address/rough area, working hours, contact channel, categories and whether goods/services are public. Default unlisted.
Owner publishes only selected offers from canonical shared-shop products; show publicly approved price and service/goods kind. Never publish cost, stock quantity, supplier/customer/staff fields.

Public responsive search by keyword, category and chosen region; do not request precise device location by default. Optional consented location may sort *approximate* distance when merchant addresses are verified; otherwise label area-based result.
Availability states: `unconfirmed`, `recently_checked`, `merchant_confirmed`, `not_available`; include last-verified timestamp. No "in stock now" unless a checked/reserved policy supports it.
Buyer can request item/quantity with clear terms without account/app installation; protect from spam, enumeration, abusive automated searches and unsolicited marketing.
Merchant reviews request, confirms price and stock, accepts/declines; no promise or financial posting until a separately approved checkout/settlement workflow.
Attribution uses non-sensitive, consented source tags; a referral/view is NOT a sale. Dashboard distinguishes impressions, qualified requests, accepted, fulfilled and *verified* sales.
Owner can pause/unpublish instantly. Refund/cancellation terms shown before confirmation.
Independent owners enroll into network with verified business profile and service area; may restrict eligible partner categories.
When owner sees shortage, generate a *draft partner request* (item spec, target quantity, timeframe, area), excluding buyer identity until explicit parties' acceptance and relevant consent.
Potential partner explicitly sends availability/price response with expiry and caveats; no direct exposure of their inventory balances or internal pricing.
Originating merchant and proposed partner accept terms (who invoices, who handles payment, fulfillment, refund, contact data, any commission) before any handoff.
Track `draft → offered → accepted/rejected/expired → fulfilled/cancelled/disputed`; each participant sees only its own permitted records and agreed information.
Commission is a transparent *proposed contract term*, never an automatic platform settlement; independent financial postings only after authority and reconciliation.
Prevent the same order being committed to multiple suppliers; implement server-side idempotency and reservation only in a later approved stock model.
Partner performance displays bounded, explained evidence rather than unverified reputation scores.
Merchant owner starts RFQ from low-stock signal, sales forecast or manual item; review quantity and units before posting.
Supplier profiles with verification status, delivery areas, minimum order quantities, lead time, quote expiry and return terms.
Collect multiple comparable quotes with explicit unit, VAT/taxes, shipping, packaging, minimums, currency, lead times and completeness labels.
Show **total landed cost** and savings relative to a documented baseline; don't claim savings if baseline is absent or non-comparable.
Optional opt-in group-buy interest pool; expose aggregate requirements only above a tested privacy threshold; don't leak merchant-level demand or competitors' costs.
Owner reviews and approves supplier, purchase terms and PO; reuse existing shop purchasing workflow where authoritative; no AI-initiated or shopper-initiated purchase.
Track quote revisions, partial supply, receipt, disputes, credit notes and delivery as distinct verified events; no auto stock increment on quote acceptance.
Avoid preferential or hidden paid ranking; label promoted suppliers and conflicts, with neutral comparison defaults.

Proactive insight categories: likely stockout, suspicious variance, slow mover, cashflow/receivable exposure, purchasing opportunity, relevant referral opportunity. Define confidence and evidence boundaries per class.
Every suggestion shows input period, source, data freshness, uncertainty, why it matters, expected impact assumptions, and **"Preview action"** or **"Dismiss"**.
Owner-only fields never surface to attendants; work with existing role-scoped `SharedShopAsk` and `shopAssistant`, not a second direct database reader.
AI/rules may propose only drafts; authorized merchant explicitly reviews an immutable diff and confirms before existing server mutation; block on stale or missing authoritative data.
For suggestions tied to money, tax, stock or purchase commitments require deterministic recalculation on the server, durable operation key and policy checks; models never author authoritative totals.
Provide opt-in AI where relevant, clear processing notice, no secret credentials in browser, no cross-tenant training or unconsented provider data sharing.
Low-connectivity/offline path gives supported deterministic local explanations; clearly label unavailable cloud inputs rather than hallucinating current data.
Feedback (useful/not useful, accepted, reverted) drives evaluation, not undisclosed automatic action.
Guest shopper can access a single signed receipt/claim link without registering; creating Passport is optional.
Shopper opts in to add a receipt to Passport; merchant and consumer identities are not silently linked across stores. Give granular per-merchant sharing/revocation controls.

Display purchase line items, date, merchant, return/warranty terms and verifiable status from actual recorded events. No paper receipt, order request or payment reference alone counts as settled proof.
Allow issue/return/warranty request, merchant acknowledgment, decision and resolution; show precise timeline and policy. Merchant remains responsible under applicable law/terms.
Merchant-configured loyalty rewards with explicit rules, expiry, fraud checks and separate financial-liability accounting; launch as non-transferable merchant perks, **not cash/stored value**.
Support shopper export, deletion request, account recovery, consent withdrawal and configurable retention while respecting statutory record retention.
No public revealing of purchase histories, phone numbers or credit information; sharing a receipt uses scoped token, revocation and abuse controls.
Transparent cross-store benefits only where each merchant and shopper explicitly join and agree; no inferred global purchase profile.
Owner-specific opt-in for *each* network track, revocation and auditable consent versions; initial network publication OFF.

prdRequirements.requirement: Precision: store GHS minor-unit money and currency, unit, exchange/tax provenance where relevant; forbid unsafe JS float accumulation for financial totals.
Accessibility WCAG 2.2 AA design target; semantic controls, 320px Android layouts, screen-reader announcements, reduced motion and keyboard operation.
Low-data mobile web; first public purchase/request without installation; clear loading/empty/error/offline/retry state.
Privacy, anti-spam, data retention, abuse appeals, rate limits, indexing controls, audit logs and redacted telemetry.
